NotificationPeriod.name: Notification Period
NotificationPeriod.definition: Minimum number of days prior to the then current expiry date by which notice of non-extension must be sent.

NotificationMethod.name: Notification Method
NotificationMethod.definition: Method by which the notice of non-extension is intended to be delivered.

NotificationRecipientType.name: Notification Recipient Type
NotificationRecipientType.definition: Type of party to whom the notice of non-extension is intended to be delivered.

NotificationRecipientName.name: Notification Recipient Name
NotificationRecipientName.definition: Name of party to whom the notice of non-extension is intended to be delivered.

NotificationRecipientAddress.name: Notification Recipient Address
NotificationRecipientAddress.definition: Address of party to whom the notice of non-extension is intended to be delivered.

NotificationTypeSPECAddressRule.definition: If NotificationRecipienType is "SPEC" (SpecifiedAddress), then NotificationRecipientAddress must be present.
